name: TransformingTrucks - OpenScad Parametric Object Toy Mockup

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a simple, stylized toy pickup truck. The front cabin section consists of a lower rectangular engine block and an upright rectangular cab block. The rear is a hollowed-out truck bed with solid walls of a defined thickness, while the bottom of the truck features four simple cylindrical wheels with recessed hub details on the sides.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric toy pickup truck in OpenSCAD with customizable dimensions. The model should include a front cab section made of two stepped blocks, a hollowed-out rear cargo bed with adjustable wall thickness, and four cylindrical wheels with recessed center details.
captions.factory: The model is constructed in three main parts: front cab, rear bed, and wheels. The front cab is created using a union of two cubes rotated and translated to form the hood and the main cabin. The rear truck bed is generated using a difference operation between a larger outer cube and a smaller inner cube to hollow it out, then rotated into position. The four wheels are individually constructed using a difference of three cylinders each to create the main tire shape and the inner axle/hub recesses, positioned at the front and back on both sides.
